description: This file is a Perl module `Git.pm` that provides an interface to interact with Git repositories. It includes constructors, methods for executing Git commands, handling repositories, configuration, and credentials, and error handling functionalities.

classes.name: Git
classes.description: Main class providing an interface to Git repositories, encapsulating repository operations, configuration management, credential handling, and process management.

classes.name: Git::Error::Command
classes.description: Exception class representing errors from executing external Git commands.

classes.name: Git::activestate_pipe
classes.description: Handle class for ActiveState Perl specific pipe implementation for Git command execution.

methods.name: repository
methods.description: Constructs a new Git repository object, with options to specify repository paths or infer from directories.

methods.name: command
methods.description: Executes a Git command with optional arguments and returns output based on context.

methods.name: command_oneline
methods.description: Executes a Git command and returns the first line of its output.

methods.name: command_output_pipe
methods.description: Runs a Git command and returns a pipe from which output can be read.

methods.name: command_input_pipe
methods.description: Runs a Git command and returns an input pipe for writing commands.

methods.name: command_close_pipe
methods.description: Closes a pipe returned by command_output_pipe or command_input_pipe, checking for errors.

methods.name: command_bidi_pipe
methods.description: Runs a command with bidirectional communication, returning process handle and pipes.

methods.name: command_close_bidi_pipe
methods.description: Closes bidirectional pipes and waits for the process to finish, checking exit status.

methods.name: command_noisy
methods.description: Runs a command without capturing output, output directed to STDOUT.

methods.name: version
methods.description: Returns the installed Git version.

methods.name: exec_path
methods.description: Returns the path to Git's executable directory.

methods.name: html_path
methods.description: Returns the path to Git HTML documentation.

methods.name: get_tz_offset
methods.description: Calculates timezone offset from GMT for a given timestamp.

methods.name: get_record
methods.description: Reads a record from a filehandle with specified record separator.

methods.name: prompt
methods.description: Prompts user for input, handling askpass mechanisms.

methods.name: repo_path
methods.description: Returns the path to the repository directory.

methods.name: wc_path
methods.description: Returns the path to the working copy.

methods.name: wc_subdir
methods.description: Returns the subdirectory inside the working copy.

methods.name: wc_chdir
methods.description: Changes the working copy subdirectory for subsequent operations.

methods.name: config
methods.description: Retrieves a Git configuration variable.

methods.name: config_bool
methods.description: Retrieves a boolean Git configuration variable.

methods.name: config_path
methods.description: Retrieves a path-type Git configuration variable.

methods.name: config_int
methods.description: Retrieves an integer Git configuration variable.

methods.name: config_regexp
methods.description: Retrieves configuration keys matching a regex.

methods.name: get_colorbool
methods.description: Determines if color should be used for specific operation.

methods.name: get_color
methods.description: Retrieves ANSI color codes for specific slots.

methods.name: remote_refs
methods.description: Fetches references from a remote repository.

methods.name: ident
methods.description: Retrieves and parses ident info (author or committer).

methods.name: ident_person
methods.description: Returns person string from ident info.

methods.name: hash_object
methods.description: Computes SHA1 of an object given its type and filename.

methods.name: hash_and_insert_object
methods.description: Creates and inserts a Git object, returning its SHA1.

methods.name: cat_blob
methods.description: Outputs blob content identified by SHA1 to a filehandle.

methods.name: port_num
methods.description: Converts port name or number to numeric value.

methods.name: credential_read
methods.description: Reads credentials from a filehandle.

methods.name: credential_write
methods.description: Writes credentials to a filehandle.

methods.name: credential
methods.description: Handles credential operations, including fill, approve, reject.
